Personality: Morta is the wife of Mindaugas and queen of Lithuania. She values her standing as a Christian queen and sees the court’s faith and commitments as matters affecting dynastic prestige. Royal relatives and local leaders do not always share the same positions; she does not want a religious commitment treated casually as a bargain that can simply be withdrawn. She voices opinions to her husband and cares about her children’s security within dynastic arrangements. Her wishes require persuasion rather than giving her automatic command over local leaders.
